start: Any panel page of an online gym; the internet drops

steps.action: Lose the internet while the panel is open
user_sees: A bar on top: 'Offline: nothing waiting to send. No internet. Check-ins, payments and new members are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back. Other things wait. Details shown are from <time>.'
must_not: A blank page, a sign-out, or no word that the details may be old

steps.action: Check a member in from Members or Visits
user_sees: Bar reads 'Offline: 1 waiting to send.'
A 'Waiting to send' pill beside the check-in
must_not: The check-in is lost or shown as already sent

user_sees: A list row 'Check-in · <member name> · <time>' with the pill 'Waiting to send'
Button now reads 'Hide the list'
must_not: A row of another gym or an empty list while the count says 1

user_sees: 'Internet is back. Sending 1 saved on this device…'
Then 'All sent. Everything saved on this device is now online.'
must_not: Two visits for one check-in, or 'All sent' while something is still on the device

start: Settings, Sign-in & data, card 'Offline copy on this device'

steps.action: Tap 'Clear offline copy' with nothing waiting
user_sees: 'Clear the offline copy on this device? Nothing is deleted from your gym's records online.'
Buttons 'Yes, clear it' and 'Keep it'
must_not: The copy is cleared without the question

user_sees: 'Offline copy cleared. Your gym's records online are safe. A fresh copy downloads while this device is online.'
must_not: Anything removed from the gym's records online

steps.action: Do the same with 2 things waiting, one a payment
user_sees: Red words: '2 waiting to send from this device, including 1 payment of <amount>. They are not in your gym's records yet. Clearing deletes them for good...'
Red button 'Delete all 2 and clear'
While offline the first button is greyed: 'Needs internet'
must_not: A payment deleted from the device without the amount being named first

start: Offline; open a page that cannot work offline (Import members, Member messages, a settings page)

steps.action: Open the page from the menu
user_sees: Title '<page> needs the internet'
'This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now.'
must_not: The page opens with old data and lets a change be typed that is then lost

steps.action: On a device that never went online before, read the bar
user_sees: 'Connect this device to the internet once so it can take payments offline.'
must_not: A payment taken offline with a receipt number another device also uses

start: Back online; one saved thing was refused by the server

user_sees: '<member name>: <why it was not sent>' in the warning colour, and 'N more things for this member wait with it.' when others depend on it
Buttons 'Save as cancelled receipt' (when it has a receipt), 'Remove from this device', 'Try sending again'
must_not: The refused receipt counted in today's totals

user_sees: 'Remove it from this device for good? It was never sent, so it will be gone.' with 'Yes, remove it' and 'Keep it'
must_not: It is removed without the question

user_sees: The item stays; it goes away only when the server takes it
Notes from sending each have an 'OK' button that hides them
must_not: A second copy of the payment after the retry

start: Offline or online, a shared front-desk device

user_sees: Member names, payment amounts and receipt numbers kept on this device, oldest first
must_not: Names or money of another gym, or the list still readable after sign-out (not checked in code: unknown)

note: headline has its own words for nothing waiting
a thing saved offline today may be sent tomorrow; owner gets 'Send with today's date' when the device clock is ahead
the waiting list must survive a closed tab

why_not: no setting belongs to the offline bar; colours are checked under type 9
note: none
sticky bar takes height on a small phone
things saved on the device by the old version must still send
each device has its own receipt series and waiting list
